ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) pixels across the fluke body with a sharp low-intensity (black) border along the trailing edge, resulting in a high contrast ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid white contiguous region across approximately 90% of the visible surface; a thin, irregular low-intensity black band follows the entire 1D boundary of the trailing edge. A single distinct dark circular blob is located in the mid-region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, symmetric V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel-based interior angle of 85-95 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude variations ranging from 5-15 pixels. The jagged peaks are more pronounced on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve starting from the distal tips, transitioning to a slight concavity as the contour approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: One high-contrast dark circular cluster (approx. 20 pixels in diameter) on the interior of the right lobe. Smaller dark clusters are embedded within the black trailing edge pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent dark pigmentation spot on the right lobe and a highly irregular, possibly necrotic or traumatized jagged edge along the distal right lobe tip.
other_distinctive_markers: The continuous black pigmentation along the trailing edge creates a 'stencil' effect against the white fluke interior.
